description: This source file defines the interface JsonPatch in the package org.eclipse.ditto.json, representing a JSON Patch with methods to create patches, retrieve patch details, convert to JSON, and an inner enum for patch operation types. It also includes static factory methods and constants for JSON fields.

classes.name: JsonPatch
classes.description: Interface representing a JSON Patch used to specify modifications on JSON Objects, supporting operations like add, remove, replace.

classes.name: JsonPatch.Operation
classes.description: Enumeration of JSON Patch operation types: add, remove, replace.

classes.name: JsonPatch.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON fields used in JSON Patch objects: op, path, value.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JSON Patch object using provided operation type, JSON Pointer path, and JSON value.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation type of the patch.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer representing the patch's target path.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the value for the patch if applicable.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representation of the patch.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the minimal JSON string representation of the patch.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Parses a string to return an Optional containing the corresponding Operation enum value.
